definitions.explanation: A place to sit, especially an assigned or designated one.

examples.japanese: {座席|ざせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{座席|ざせき}
{座席|ざせき}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧

⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座席|ざせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓側|まどがわ}→窓側：19397_madogawa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{通路側|つうろがわ}→通路側：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat on the plane?

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座席|ざせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すべて→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れていた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{入|はい}ること→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: All the concert seats were sold out, but a cancellation opened up on the day and I was able to get in.

notes:
{座席|ざせき} refers to an assigned or designated seat, more formal than ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{座席|ざせき}: reserved seat
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{座席|ざせき}: unreserved seat
- {座席|ざせき}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: seat number
- {座席|ざせき}⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧: seat belt
- ⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧{座席|ざせき}: priority seat (for elderly, pregnant, etc.)

AIRPLANE/TRAIN SEATS:
- ⟦{窓側|まどがわ}→窓側：19397_madogawa⟧{座席|ざせき}: window seat
- ⟦{通路|つうろ}→通路：04062_tsuuro⟧⟦{側|がわ}→側：noentry⟧{座席|ざせき}: aisle seat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: seat (more casual, broader usage — also means "place" at a gathering)
- {座席|ざせき}: specifically a physical seat, often numbered or assigned
